name: Deauville seaside villa
description: Belle Epoque seaside villa of the Deauville coast, 15 x 10.6 m: a brick ground floor with stone dressings, a half-timbered first floor and a steep tiled roof with a cross gable and dormers; a timber porch over the front door, railed balconies on the front and the east side, a lateral brick chimney. Salon, hall and dining room; two bedrooms; an open attic; two stairs.
